body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am interested in OrthoIQ and the work you are doing on sensing and feedback for orthopedic surgical tools, and wanted to reach out about the Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineering Intern role.

My background includes bare metal microcontroller firmware, sensor and motor control on embedded systems, and hands on circuit board design and fabrication, so I think this lines up well with the role.

I was not sure who the best contact is for open roles on the embedded and firmware side. If you could point me toward the right person that would help a lot.
hook_used: No specific personal hook available for a company page, genuine interest in product stated directly per rule. Redrafted under 750 characters at request.
